title: CONNECT-UDP Early Datagram Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9298 early-datagram policy.
scope: This verification covers early HTTP Datagram drop/buffer classification, processing when the request is known, buffering-limit policy, and client optimistic datagram sending before response.
preconditions: RFC 9298 datagram Context ID codec is trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused early-datagram tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 early-datagram artifacts, generated triage reflects the slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9298 early-datagram policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Live buffering queues and request association remain future adapter work.
